editable: Every field can be changed by hand. Defaults are suggestions.

id.label: Creative ID
id.rule: Designer prefix + 3 digits. Auto next number on this page. Never reuse an ID.

date.label: Date
date.rule: MM.DD.YY, the day the frame is finished.

concept.label: Concept
concept.rule: Short human title, max 30 chars. Illegal characters are stripped automatically.

version.label: Version
version.rule: V1 = first cut of this concept. V2+ = a re-skin of the same concept.

designer.label: Designer
designer.rule: Who built the file. Sets the ID prefix.

market.label: Market
market.rule: Which store it is built for. Mkt-All when it ships to every store unchanged.
meanings: Mkt-US = United States
Mkt-UK = United Kingdom
Mkt-AU = Australia
Mkt-CA = Canada
Mkt-DE = Germany
Mkt-NL = Netherlands
Mkt-All = ships to every store unchanged

event.label: Event / season
event.rule: What moment the ad is built for. Evergreen when none.

product.label: Product
product.rule: Hero product. Multi when 2+ knives share the frame.

avatar.label: Avatar
avatar.rule: Who the ad talks to. Always ONE named avatar. There is no 'everyone'.
meanings: MIKE = MIKE - BBQ King
JOHN = JOHN - Knife Collector
STEVE = STEVE - Home Cook
SARAH = SARAH - The Wife (gifter)
VANCE = VANCE - The Opportunist (deal seeker)
DON = DON - The Hunter
COLE = COLE - The Camper / Bushcraft
DANA = DANA - Knife Sharpener
DARIEN = DARIEN - Proud Parents

funnel.label: Funnel role
funnel.rule: Top of funnel finds new people (First Click). Middle warms them. Bottom closes people who already know us.
meanings: Fun-TOF = top of funnel: finds new people, judged on First Click ROAS
Fun-MOF = middle of funnel: warms people who saw us once, not yet buyers
Fun-BOF = bottom of funnel: closes people who already know us

lp.label: Landing page
meanings: PDP = product page
6r-General = 6 Reasons listicle, general
6r-Feather = 6 Reasons, Feather
6r-Blackout = 6 Reasons, LOKI Blackout
6r-Santoku = 6 Reasons, BJORN Santoku
6r-Sharpener = 6 Reasons, Rolling Sharpener
3r-General = 3 Reasons, general
7r-Blackout = 7 Reasons, Blackout
Collection Page = collection page
Offer Page = offer / promo page
BYS = build your set
VIP = VIP free-gift page

angle.label: Messaging angle
angle.rule: What the ad argues. One angle per ad (Ridge: angle identifier; Motion: messaging angle).
meanings: Value Offer = the deal is the argument (B2G2, price, gift)
Craftsmanship = hand-forged, months to make, the maker's story
Scarcity = stock, batch, deadline, last units
Product Proof = what the blade does: the cut, the weight, the grip
Social Proof = reviews, customers, sold-out counts
Brand Story = who we are, transparency, apology, behind the scenes
Identity = the kind of person who owns this (pitmaster, collector)
Collection = display, set, centerpiece, the shelf
Upgrade = your old knife vs this one
Gifting = buying it for someone else
Objection = answers a doubt: too sharp, too pretty, too expensive
Humor = the joke carries it
Education = teaches something first (hack, how-to, why)
Durability = outlasts, survives, heirloom

hook.label: Hook tactic
hook.rule: How the headline grabs, not the words (Motion: hook tactic).
meanings: Bold Claim = a flat statement: 'Sharpest knife you will own'
Question = asks the reader something
Confession = we messed up / sorry / we made too many
Warning = don't buy / careful / this is not for you
Number = a stat or count leads: '3 months to forge'
Callout = names the reader: 'If you grill every weekend'
Contrarian = says the opposite of what ads say
Story = starts mid-scene: 'He hasn't touched his old set since'
Command = tells them what to do: 'Keep scrolling'

tone.label: Tone
meanings: Tone-Blunt = raw, short, the real NK voice
Tone-Funny = meme, joke, wink
Tone-Urgent = deadline, last units, now
Tone-Warm = gift, family, heirloom
Tone-Serious = craft, proof, no jokes

offer.label: Offer shown
offer.rule: The offer visible IN the ad, not the offer live on site.

offerRole.label: Offer placement
offerRole.rule: Where the offer sits. House rule: it resolves the subject, it never IS the headline.
meanings: Off-Badge = small badge or sticker, the message is something else
Off-Body = inside the copy, after the setup
Off-Headline = the offer IS the headline (avoid; flag when you do it)
Off-Absent = no offer on the canvas

price.label: Price shown
price.rule: Is a price or a compared-at price visible?
meanings: Prc-Shown = a price or compared-at price is visible
Prc-Hidden = no number on the canvas

proof.label: Proof element
proof.rule: Which trust device is on the canvas.
meanings: Prf-None = no trust device
Prf-Reviews = quoted review text
Prf-Stars = star rating only
Prf-Count = a number: customers, sold out X times
Prf-Guarantee = money-back / warranty (terms must be confirmed)
Prf-Press = media / as seen in
Prf-Maker = the blacksmith, the forge, the process

copyLen.label: Copy length
meanings: Len-Short = up to 8 words
Len-Mid = 9 to 25 words
Len-Long = 26+ words (Long-Form Copy device)

copyBy.label: Copy written by
copyBy.rule: Who wrote the words on the ad.
meanings: Cpy-Designer = designer wrote it
Cpy-Strategist = from the brief
Cpy-Bank = taken from the Notion copy bank
Cpy-Claude = AI-written, human-checked

format.label: Visual format
format.rule: The device the ad borrows. Pick from the Notion menu; ask before inventing a new one.
meanings: Specs Table = product spec sheet as the ad
Spinning Wheel = prize wheel landing on the offer
Media Article = news or magazine article mock
Sorry Letter = apology / letter from the brand (runs twice weekly)
Testimonials = review cards, stars, quotes
Arcade Machine = slot / claw / arcade cabinet
Apple Note = iPhone Notes app screenshot
Meme = borrowed meme template
Dont Buy = DON'T BUY XX pattern interrupt
We Messed Up = confession headline, overstock / mistake
iPhone Story = IG story UI with stickers
Billboard Street = ad mocked onto a street billboard
Reddit = r/ thread with upvotes and replies
Cartoon Drawing = illustrated / comic style
iPhone Popup = REMINDER / system popup on a phone
iMessage = text-message thread
INFO Style = steps + labels, minimal text
Compared At = price comparison, ours vs compared-at
Email = forwarded email / inbox screenshot
Big Word Hero = one giant word carries the frame
Find Yours = grid: which one is you
Use-Case Cloud = product in the middle, uses around it
Icon Grid = benefits as an icon grid
Persona Callout = 'for the guy who...' callout
Iceberg = what you see vs what's underneath
Would You Rather = two-choice poll
Emoji Math = emoji + emoji = product
Stat Stack = stacked numbers
Money-Back Timeline = guarantee as a timeline (blocked until terms confirmed)
Casting Call = wanted / casting poster
Search History = Google / browser search history
Story Comic = multi-panel comic strip
Seasonal Diorama = miniature scene for the season
3D Spokesperson = 3D character presents the product
Product Hero = clean product shot + headline (was 'Promotional')
Lifestyle Photo = product in a real scene, hands, grill, board
Long-Form Copy = product in a corner, real paragraph copy (NK147 device)
Sticky Note = handwritten note stuck on the product
Whiteboard = hand-drawn explanation on a board
Annotation Overlay = marker circles and arrows on a photo
Stock Bar = low-stock progress bar / inventory UI
Us vs Them = ours right, theirs left
Before After = same outcome, two moments
Split Screen = two halves, one message
Receipt = receipt / invoice mock
Checklist = ticked list next to the product
Handwritten Note = paper note, pen, not a Post-it
Missing Poster = lost / wanted poster parody
Collector Card = trading-card layout
Membership Card = club / VIP card
Movie Poster = film poster layout
Typography Poster = type-only poster
Retro Poster = vintage ad style
Blueprint = technical drawing of the knife
Comment Reply = reply to a comment / AMA
Google Search = search bar with autocomplete
ChatGPT Chat = AI chat conversation
Trustpilot = review-platform UI
Breaking News = news chyron / ticker
Native Post = looks like an organic post
Text on Skin = copy written on a hand or arm
Venn Diagram = two circles, product in the overlap
Myth vs Fact = two columns, myths struck through
Tier List = S/A/B/C ranking
Crossed Out = pains struck through in red
X Signs = '5 signs your knives are done'
Warning Label = hazard / side-effects label
Zero Stars = a bad review reframed
Bundle Stack = what's in the box, what it's worth
X Reasons = numbered reasons list
Carousel Cover = first slide of a carousel
Surreal Scale = giant knife in a real scene
Warehouse Shot = overstock / crates / shelves
Toy Packaging = knife as an action figure / toy box

media.label: Image origin
media.rule: How the main visual was made.
meanings: Gen-AI = main visual is AI generated
Gen-AIMix = AI visual + real product photo composited
Gen-Photo = real photograph / photoshoot
Gen-3D = 3D render
Gen-UI = device or app mock (Notes, iMessage, Reddit, search)
Gen-Drawn = illustration, cartoon, whiteboard, handwriting

text.label: Text weight
text.rule: How much of the ad is words.
meanings: Txt-Only = words are the ad, no product visual
Txt-Led = headline dominates, product supports
Txt-Light = visual leads, a line or two of copy

compare.label: Comparison
compare.rule: Does the ad put two things side by side, and which kind?
meanings: Cmp-None = no side-by-side
Cmp-Product = our knife vs theirs / vs the old one / vs our other knife
Cmp-Situation = before vs after, with vs without, then vs now
Cmp-Emotion = frustration vs relief, embarrassment vs pride

shot.label: Product shot
shot.rule: How the knife appears (Nectar tracked product orientation the same way).
meanings: Shot-Hero = knife alone, clean, front or angled
Shot-InHand = held, not cutting
Shot-InUse = cutting, on the board, on the grill
Shot-Flatlay = top-down arrangement
Shot-Set = several knives as a set / display
Shot-Detail = macro: edge, handle, engraving
Shot-None = no product visual

human.label: Person on image
human.rule: Is there a person, and are they happy or reacting?
meanings: Hum-Happy = a person visibly happy with the knife (smile, pride)
Hum-Reaction = a person reacting: shock, surprise, disbelief, laughing
Hum-Neutral = a person or hands, no expression
Hum-None = no person

palette.label: Palette
palette.rule: Overall ground of the frame (Ridge: colorway).
meanings: Pal-Dark = dark ground (black, charcoal, forge)
Pal-Light = light ground (white, paper, cream)
Pal-Color = saturated colour ground (orange, blue, red)
Pal-Photo = the photo is the ground

fidelity.label: Fidelity
fidelity.rule: Polished brand look vs deliberately rough / native (HexClad: hi-fi vs lo-fi).
meanings: Fid-Hi = polished, brand-grade
Fid-Lo = rough on purpose: native, screenshot, handwritten, meme

category.label: Category
category.rule: New = net-new idea. Ite = iteration of our own ad. Adapt = adapted from another brand's ad.
meanings: New = net-new idea
Ite = iteration of our own ad
Adapt = adapted from another brand (put the brand in Adapted from)

source.label: Adapted from
source.rule: Only when Category is Adapt. Src-Other followed by the brand name with no spaces. Src-None for New and Ite.

ratio.label: Ratio
ratio.rule: Read from the frame size in Figma. 1x1, 4x5 or 9x16.
